content:
To avoid stealing the spotlight from the new Mac mini and Mac Studio, Apple also launched an updated Polishing Cloth today. In an era where everything is getting more expensive, the new Polishing Cloth is actually cheaper than before, costing just $9 (previously $19).

What changes have been made to this new Polishing Cloth is unknown, as Apple's product description for the new version is exactly the same as before:

Apple launched the Polishing Cloth in October 2021, and it sold out almost immediately. Although the product has become an internet meme, it is indeed a high-quality cleaning cloth, perfect for taking care of your Apple products.

You can order this 'new' Polishing Cloth from Apple's official website today for $9. When I say you'd better order it quickly, I'm only half joking — because it really might sell out fast.

If you want to collect a piece of Apple history, the original Polishing Cloth is still available on Amazon for $19.
